mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate trend consistently compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.5% for two consecutive months, it signals deepening economic distress, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 9.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in labor force participation (PAYEMS) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a weakening demand cycle, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (PAYEMS * RSAFS) has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns are positive in > 55% of cases when both series decline.

mechanism_narrative: In a near-zero interest rate environment (FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%), the Federal Reserve's commitment to low rates supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions, which consistently support positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS shows a positive trend over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 650,000 units for two consecutive months, it indicates a weakening housing market, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST falls below 650.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals stagflation, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (CPIAUCSL * INDPRO) has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns are positive in > 55% of cases when CPIAUCSL rises and INDPRO falls.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing supply shock (INDPRO < 100 for 3 consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 days due to reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0 for 3 consecutive months.
